change: The production layer resource observer runs in Coax. Coax owns VPK framing/traversal, source and decoded-image byte identity, compiled-owner selection, upload ranges, metadata/hash admission, finalization and textures.config. Browser JavaScript is narrow reason1 SDK effects.

qualification.scope: Owned policy root procedures; existing dependency checks retained.
qualification.parity: All stable resource status/browser fields and every original shared-source hash agree. Native cmp checks every raw byte; Coax independently checks complete hashes and exact mip layout. Texture configurations are byte-identical after canonicalizing only the declared owned raw-file path.
qualification.refusals: VPK magic/length/table/unselected-span, actual ImageBitmap decode failure, wrong profile, empty selected layer part, short/corrupt physical transport, and source changes both before upload and after ACK.
qualification.retained_red: Original matrix8/9 is retained: the ten-digit int32 profile was incorrectly rejected by a nine-digit helper before package admission. A tested canonical int32 parser repairs it; only the changed Coax side was rerun and joined to the unchanged original exit1. Initial /tmp versus /private/tmp texture-config refusal is also retained.
qualification.source_failure: Both controlled source changes retain structured failed receipts and publish no qualified layer artifact. The after-ACK case records one complete POST followed by failed final source ownership.

provenance.compiler_scope: Explicit qualified historical compiler; actual image and source inputs retained. No current-main compiler or new product-emission claim.
provenance.source_epochs: Exact earlier source bytes are recovered by authored inverse changes and required to match stamped source SHA256 values. Complete native shasum-c joins pass for all observing epochs; no historical source was executed or restored into the repository.
provenance.reused_gpu_scope: Packed/individual observations precede the narrow CLI/failed-receipt repairs. Their exact Wasm, production renderer, package/image inputs and every captured byte remain unchanged and are replayed through the final policy. Actual historical tool images are kept distinct from final-source emission.

limits: Layer resource conformance only; no whole-realm frame, new shader/producer build or new native/CPU numerical result.
Existing64MiB input file fences remain. The original256MiB capture envelope uses up to4explicit64MiB POST sinks and Coax assembly/hash; shared RTO policy was not enlarged or changed.
Canonical decimal int32 profiles are explicit; incidental JavaScript Number coercions are not part of the new CLI contract.
Original180s browser/30s CDP limits remain, with muted headless Chrome only. Volatile refusal stacks/request ordering are not asserted equal.
Shared origin/session/production-renderer sources and prior POST/renderer-math gates remain unchanged and are reused.
